preconditions.description: The length of the string L must be between 1 and 200000.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == L and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must have length L and consist only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output must be the length of the longest string that appears at least twice.

postconditions.expression: max_length == 0 if not any(len(sub) > 1 for sub in substrings) else max_length > 0
postconditions.description: If no substring appears at least twice, the output must be zero; otherwise, it must be the length of the longest such substring.
